notes.title: Announcing Shadowhand Solitaire! Wishlist Now.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/0445c5eefb455b53c0d5a57a449e4395392029f8.gif[/img]
[h1]NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT!
Shadowhand Solitaire is coming very soon to Steam...
We're super proud of this swashbuckling solitaire adventure and we think you'll love it![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/

Shadowhand Solitaire is a casual, solitaire-only edition of Shadowhand: RPG Card Game with no turn-based combat. Gameplay is similar to other hit games in the series: Regency Solitaire & Regency Solitaire II.

notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now [b]change language[/b] for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/
